objective: Freeze an external corpus authored outside Hawkar-usls/JANUS before mapping HIDDEN-001, HIDDEN-002 or HIDDEN-003. Selection uses repository identity, exact commit identity and JSON path only; selected JSON bodies are not used to choose membership.

selection_protocol.repository_pool_policy: Purposefully domain-diverse public repositories with independent governance/authorship. This is an external transport panel, not an unbiased sample of GitHub or a population-prevalence study.
selection_protocol.path_discovery_primary: Git recursive-tree enumeration without body checkout.
selection_protocol.connector_limitation: Large recursive-tree responses are truncated by the connector.
selection_protocol.preclassification_fallback: For each frozen repository commit, use GitHub code search query '.json'; consume returned path order only. Select the first three returned paths whose path literally ends in .json after technical exclusions.
technical_exclusions: any JSON path whose body was accidentally exposed by latest-commit diff metadata before this receipt was frozen
selection_protocol.no_replacement_rule: If a frozen repository yields fewer than three eligible paths under the bounded selector, keep the deficit. Do not replace it with a more convenient repository or query after seeing the outcome.
classification_features_forbidden_during: semantic reading of selected JSON bodies

known_pre_freeze_metadata_contamination.rule: These paths are ineligible for the panel because commit metadata exposed body/diff content before the selection receipt was frozen.

next_gate: Freeze SUPPORT/WEAK_SUPPORT/CONTRADICTION/NOT_APPLICABLE rubric for HIDDEN-001/002/003 before opening any selected JSON body; then classify all 12 without replacement and run relation-destroying controls where source structure permits.
